name: Morris❤️
source:
They’re UPGRADING the computer at the local library!  They’re even installing a NEW GAME!  We GOTTA check it out when they’re done!

Soon, you’ll be able to meet MORRIS as your date in a new installment of the ‘DATE TIME’ SOFTWARE GAME SERIES!

He might come off as COLD, but tap into his SOFTER SIDE and it’ll reveal a WARM person who might only be ACTING TOUGH because he has a 💗💗💗CRUSH ON YOU!💗💗💗

“Morris💗” is the ‘spiritual sequel’ to “Melissa💗”.  

This time you will take the role of suitor towards a tsundere boy who is struggling between different feelings.  WHAT FEELINGS, YOU ASK?  You’ll just need to find out!

The game will be a little bit longer than Melissa💗, but will feature a “different” type of horror and scenario to the events of Melissa💗.  

Wait, did I say horror?  Silly me.  I mean, ROMANCE.  A DIFFERENT TYPE OF ROMANCE!  I KNOW I COULD EASILY JUST EDIT THE LAST SENTENCE OUT, BUT I AM AN OPEN BOOK.

[Edited from [url=https://cattrigger.itch.io/morris-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
